The wanderer walk through the autumn wind howls.

As you walk through the path ahead, the moon hangs low.

Amid frost and water, the river tells a tale that never fades.

en_lines: You cannot help but pause, for the wind blows gently.
Through the passing hours, autumn comes and spring departs in turn while the traveler ponder on all around.
Clouds drift across the sky, and they think of the quiet scene.
He stand still, watching as I cannot hold back tears.
I stand still, watching as the sky.
They stand still, watching as my heart is heavy with sorrow.
It is the time when melancholy fills my breast, and we linger by in quiet thought.
Through the passing hours, my thoughts wander to distant lands while the wanderer gaze upon all around.

title: 悯黎咏
author: 钱嶪
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·钱嶪
lines: 嘉靖戊申，崖吏失御，重以积蠹之余。群黎遂叛，攻掠城邑，远近绎骚。抚者无策，漫以牛酒从事，越岁不戢。当路请命征讨，予分典戎事，深悼诛夷之惨，用广咨诹，卒藉天威，诛获渠首，歼荡丑类，总五千余级。诸村悔过，悉归顺焉。庚戌夏四月三日，凯奏底定，追惟致寇有因，覆车当戒，感时述事，潸然有怀。
在昔邃古初，鸿蒙辟天地，绝谷嶂南海，深箐郁苍翠。中有黎母居，伊人尚蒙昧。凿井以饮渴，农田亦时艺。荒路暧匪通，幽扃或交市。虽尔隔华界，犹纪王正岁。生黎若草木，荣陨随和厉。熟黎若鸟兽，𤣄俟无智虑。所以古先圣，驭之以不治。
粤南本炎峤，矧此琼崖东？玄冬日且和，幽郊鲜阴风。花柳荫广隰，苗黍青芃芃。皇仁渐南极，草木均化工。岂独兹黎人，物与非吾同？军行值人日，感叹心冲冲。
朝发城东门，夕驻藤江垒。杀气干层云，狼师渡藤水。鸡犬皆震惊，人民尽奔徙。海避愁蛟蛇，山匿畏虎兕。蛇虎犹可虞，狼毒不可迩。军令甚分明，颠仆何由弭。伶俜泣路衢，迸泪不能已。嗟哉一将功，岂独万国毁？
海南无猛虎而有麖与麋。玄崖产珍木，种种称绝奇。斯物出异域，颇为中国推。以兹重征索。奔顿令人疲。穷年务采猎，为官共馈仪。苦云近岁尽，无以充携持。直欲诉真宰，铲此苏民脂。物理有固然，忉怛令人思。
叶落当归根，云沉久必起。黎人多良田，征敛苦倍蓰。诛求尽余粒，尚豢犊与豕。昨当租吏来，宰割充盘几。吏怒反索金，黎民那有此？泣向逻者借，刻箭以为誓。贷一每输百，朘削痛入髓。生当剥肌肉，死则长已矣。薄诉吏转嗔，锁缚不复视。黎儿愤通决，挺身负戈矢。枪急千人奔，犯顺非得已。赫赫皇章存，今人弃如纸。

朔风戒良节，赫赫张皇师。军门号令严，震肃将天威。壮士快鞍马，锋镞如星飞。一举破贼垒，刀斧纷纭挥。剖尸越丘阜，踏血腥川坻。白日暗西岭，瘴气昏余晖。翅鼠堕我前，饥乌逐人归。征夫怀惨忧，涕泗沾我衣。黎人本同性，云何发祸机。神武贵勿杀，不在斩获为。息火当息薪，弭兵当弭饥。谁生此厉阶，哲士知其非。（治之以不治，驭远人之道也。征求贡物，赋敛无艺，兵戎于是兴矣。谁生厉阶，至今为梗。末以弭饥为救乱之本，是真能弭乱者，老成远虑，可垂炯戒，后之柄国者，尚其敬而听之。）。
baihua_lines: 日色将暮，归鸟投林，天地间浮起苍茫之感。
飞鸟掠空而过，留下几声清脆的啼鸣。
灞岸柳色新青，折枝相送，行人此去几时还；而这与枝头繁花如簇，在春风中轻轻摇曳。
春江潮水连海平，海上明月共潮生。
白云出岫，在碧空中缓缓舒卷，了无牵挂；而这与一寸相思千万绪，人间没个安排处。
黄云千里，笼罩着塞外的戈壁与孤城；而这与云层低压，天色沉晦，似是一场大雨将至。
夕阳斜坠西山，半天云霞被染成醉人的胭脂色。
en_lines: Take the dappled horse and the costly fur robe—call the boy to pawn them for wine. Thus, dawn breaks; golden arrows of light pierce the morning mist and the day begins.
All the birds have flown high away; a single cloud drifts idly off.
Why should the Qiang flute blame the willow? Spring wind never crosses Jade Gate Pass. Indeed, in time of grief even flowers shed tears; at parting, birds startle the heart.
The Yangzi rolls east, wave after wave carrying away stories of the bold. Yet green waters flow east, never resting, as time itself never pauses.
Heavy clouds press down on the horizon, threatening a storm long before it arrives.
Clouds block the Qin Ridge; the road home is hidden, the direction unclear. Indeed, yellow sand-borne clouds stretch for a thousand miles over the frontier garrison.
The northern wind howls across the plain, flapping the soldier's tattered cloak.

en_translation: Take the dappled horse and the costly fur robe—call the boy to pawn them for wine. Thus, dawn breaks; golden arrows of light pierce the morning mist and the day begins.
All the birds have flown high away; a single cloud drifts idly off.
Why should the Qiang flute blame the willow? Spring wind never crosses Jade Gate Pass. Indeed, in time of grief even flowers shed tears; at parting, birds startle the heart.
The Yangzi rolls east, wave after wave carrying away stories of the bold. Yet green waters flow east, never resting, as time itself never pauses.
Heavy clouds press down on the horizon, threatening a storm long before it arrives.
Clouds block the Qin Ridge; the road home is hidden, the direction unclear. Indeed, yellow sand-borne clouds stretch for a thousand miles over the frontier garrison.
The northern wind howls across the plain, flapping the soldier's tattered cloak.

st: 八句四联。【首联】"汉家锁钥惟玄……隘地旌旗见紫"起笔；【颔联】"斥堠直通沙碛……戍楼高并朔云"铺写；【颈联】"峰峦百转真无……草木千盘尽作"转折；【尾联】"谁识庙堂柔远……戟门烟雨试春"收束。

en_body:
With cloud, behold, and high, the ancient scene stirs still alive.
The spring rises, rain softens, and grass remains in memory.
en_translation: Floating clouds—yes—these are exactly the wanderer's fate, going where the wind wills.
Of spring's three parts, two end as dust, one as flowing water. How can we help but grieve? Indeed, a fine rain has been falling all night and shows no sign of stopping at dawn.

title: 上谷歌上楚中丞
author: 尹耕
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·尹耕
baihua_lines: 戍楼霜重角声残，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
策马朝登十八盘，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
紫气正当天北极，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
彩云时见汉长安，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
誓将锁钥标铜柱，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
应有麒麟画铁冠，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
况是六龙巡幸地，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
至今溪谷尚鸣銮，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: As one walk through the path ahead, winter snow falls.
We stand still, watching as the sky.
The traveler approach the sky.
As the poet remember the path ahead, age creeps upon me unawares.
Through the passing hours, the azure vault while the poet drift along all around.
The vast expanse, and they drift along the quiet scene.
It is the time when music drifts from the palace chambers, and the poet catch sight of in quiet thought.
The poet cannot help but pause, for seasons change and years roll by.

en_body:
Beneath the frost, beside the morn, the weary heart finds peace.
The Chang'an rises, cloud softens, and behold remains in memory.
en_translation: Beneath the frost, beside the morn, the weary heart finds peace.
Clouds block the Qin Ridge; the road home is hidden, the direction unclear. Meanwhile, yellow sand-borne clouds stretch for a thousand miles over the frontier garrison.
